english: This version is about fixes. A save that fails half way no longer loses the file it replaces, and the auto-backups of two TraceDraws, or of two drawings of the same name, no longer overwrite each other. Large drawings stay quick: Group, Combine, Ungroup and Undo of tens of thousands of objects take a fraction of a second, and deeply nested drawings open again. Saved as .cdr, a drawing keeps its hidden layers, pattern and mesh fills, emoji, line breaks and spot colour gradients. PDF, SVG, EPS and EMF files come in and go out closer to what they show: outlined text, gradients, fading transparencies, turned pictures, Hebrew and Arabic. Convert to Curves keeps each word's colour, a guideline can be taken over any object, and Combine selects its result. On Windows, TraceDraw no longer slows the whole computer by starting a process every few seconds, and on tablets Shift, Ctrl and Alt lock with two taps.

english: This version is about fixes. In text, Shift+Enter breaks the line, numbered bullets can be read again, drop caps keep to their number of lines, and Convert to Curves keeps overlapping letters. Tracing runs in a window with its progress and Cancel, so the program no longer looks frozen. Exported pictures keep every edge of the page, with no light line along the border, and saving as .cdr no longer leaves out lines of no length. Imported pictures keep their colour mode, .cdr clones stay linked to their master, and .cdr pattern transparencies and right-to-left fonts open. On touch screens the Pen goes on from the last node, the 2-point line follows the finger and Objects docker rows can be dragged. Guidelines have a menu in the Objects docker, the grid starts at the top of the page, and a DXF file of deeply nested blocks no longer runs out of memory. Classic .ai files from tracing programs open in colour and grouped, and Enter in the Contour boxes applies the contour.

english: The Shape Builder tool merges or takes away the parts of overlapping objects with a drag, and the Join tool joins the ends of curves with one stroke. Spreadsheets (.xlsx, CSV, TSV) open as live tables, formulas go in with Object > Insert > Formula, and text can run right to left, with numbered bullets and columns of different widths. Print can tile a poster over several sheets of paper, put each plate in its own file with its own halftone screen, and print two-sided by hand. Layer Effects stack glows, bevels and shadows live on an object. Help > Benchmark scores the computer, and Light zoom helps slow ones. .cdr files keep their B-spline curves, perspectives and radial transparencies. Fixes from your videos: shadows stay on their objects and break apart, the zoom box shows the real zoom, each palette scrolls on its own, Select All leaves locked objects alone, and panel tabs keep their names. .tdraw files are much smaller: each picture is stored once, compressed, and imported JPEGs are kept as they are, with a loading bar for big files. Older files still open, but a file saved by 0.47 or later opens only in 0.47 or later.

english: Perspective works on pictures, and a click on a blend's steps selects the whole blend. Convert Outline to Object, Weld, Trim and Combine work inside groups, Flatten Effects breaks off drop shadows, and objects dragged onto the Color Styles docker become colour styles. Palette colours fill table cells chosen with the Pick or Shape tool, and the scale fields show how far an object is scaled. Print Preview turns one page on its own and keeps objects across the spine of facing pages, a PDF can open as pictures, and PDF export keeps gradient transparency and drop shadows. DXF files open in AutoCAD, .cdr artistic text sits where the file places it, and files dropped on the window on Windows are no longer lost.
